summary: Plan Revision 2 is approved for the bounded verification attempt. Independent re-review confirms PBR-001 now defines a deterministic status contract and eight expected cases; PBR-002 distinguishes the exact candidate PR #221 route from current main and requires actual Host route/result lineage with a fail-closed stop before product mutation if the candidate cannot be selected; PBR-003 identifies the registered #开发/development.task authorization issuer and separates task authorization from Host write-scope admission. This is Plan approval only: no live candidate route invocation, product mutation, durable authorization issuance, or canonical Run evidence is claimed. The absent devforge/execution-evidence ref and candidate route selection must be resolved through their existing registered mechanisms before dependent execution steps; unavailable capabilities remain blockers, not successful completion.

reviewed_prior_findings.review: The exact function contract, accepted values, trim/lowercase mapping, TypeError/ValueError behavior and eight table-driven cases are explicit; scope remains confined to the isolated fixture.

The plan pins PR #221 HEAD separately from current main, names the route registry/adapter sources, requires actual selected-route and Bridge result lineage, forbids static declaration/direct tool success as route proof, and stops before product mutation if no existing authorized selector is available. Live candidate route execution is not claimed by this review.

The plan preserves legacy_command_scoped during remediation, names the explicit #开发/development.task issuer for any later exact-task authorization issuance/readback, and separately requires Host write-scope admission. No authorization is issued or broadened.

route_validation_boundary.required_before_product_mutation: Prove the existing authorized Host mechanism selected the exact candidate Runtime HEAD and bind actual Bridge tool results; otherwise stop at the unavailable route boundary.

preserved_boundaries: Approval does not start implementation or authorize a product-code mutation.
No Durable Development Authorization was issued, broadened, or migrated.
